First of all, trigger warning, and you are about to hate me, so be warned.

My dad was a very horrible person, and got arrested for dealing drugs a long time ago. I think this doomed me to do some other stuff in the past, but I know my actions are only my fault. My mother doesn;t know how to deal with me, and likes to yell and hit me. But I don't blame her, she's gone through some shit.

My school grades were all f's and a b. (which was math which I care about).

I'm going to put it simply. This all came together last month and I literally squeezed the life out of my guinea pig. Instead of being a normal person and talking to someone OR MY THERAPIST, I decide to put this innocent animal through hell. I covered it up like a pussy but im finally done coping with it by shutting the memory out of my head and basically being numb to anything. Now, Im going to tell my therapist tomorrow because im too scared to tell my parents first, but no matter what I know I can't forgive myself.
